notes.title: Open the door to the nightmare at 80% off!
notes.content: Welcome to a world where the creepiest and most inexplicable events lurk behind every door. Face nightmares that will make you doubt reality. Your survival depends only on your courage and responsiveness. Play before it's too late....

notes.title: Over 10,000 copies have been sold!
notes.content:
[b]Thank you so much for your support![/b]

I used all the money I earned to develop and create other games.

I already have a roadmap for the games that I will produce.

The release of Pathogen X is waiting for you in the near future 
After that, work on the psychological horror will be completed.
There is also a 2d adventure quest in development, with a very cute visual style and an interesting story.

[b]You guys are great![/b]

I will be grateful to all of you in the future for your support!

notes.content:
You can try [b]Pathogen X demo[/b] right now, it will be available for a limited time

[b]Do not forget to add the game to the wishlist, a good discount will be waiting for you on the day of release![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508980/PATHOGEN_X/]-> Link to download demo <-[/url]

I want to [b]THANK![/b] everyone who supported me on the release of my first game [b]"OPEN DOOR"[/b] 

In the near future, I will release an announcement of the next horror and another game.

I will only say that this is a psychological thriller about a man who is undergoing treatment for his consciousness in order to deal with his internal conflicts.

[b]Thank you again very much, you mean a lot to me![/b]

notes.title: FIX GAME LAUNCH
notes.content:
Guys!
I have a little news

I want to say that I solved the problem with the error that prevented the launch of the game.

It looks like the problem was hidden in the code related to the Turkish language.

But I'm not completely sure if everything turned out to be fixed
I will continue to check the code for operability

But in the near future, I hope to release an update soon with the transition to the 5th version of the engine.

There you will find a new interactive menu plus an additional story company in a new place and a new environment.

Thank you so much for informing me about this problem!

And once again, I ask for huge forgiveness from everyone who could not launch the game immediately after installation!

You are the best!

It is very nice to know that I am supported by people like you!

I will try to release games for you more often and better as soon as I recruit a development team of at least 4 people.

You can expect that every story addition in every game will always be free.

Thank you for everything!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42842969/916346d2d0767eba76177ff35a09ac0e71312ccd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Discount on the developer's birthday!!!
notes.content:
As you understand from the post, today is my birthday.

I was born in the spring on May 12 and since this is my favorite time of the year, I decided to make a weekly discount in honor of this event.

If you want to support me or just give me a gift, you can buy the game or leave a review under the game on the steam page, if you haven't done it yet, or just have a drink in my honor, since I'm a little sick.

Thank you so much for your support, I really care about all of you.

I hope that I will be able to please you soon with a new project ( I keep it in some secret )

Therefore, follow the news and videos on YouTube.

Have a great and the best day to everyone!!!

notes.title: Game Fix 1.17
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.17[/b]

1. Added machine localization to :
[b]Turkish[/b]
[b]Polish[/b]

2. Fixed a bug with falling through the floor for some players, added additional blocks.

3. Changing the damage screen.
 ( for a more convenient overview of the player )
Added 50% transparency and display sequence.

4. Added hints on the use of items in different places of passage. ( pills, books )

5. Added infinite spawn of books, on the 1st floor, when the book misses the lever.

6. Added a block when falling out of the ventilation in the kitchen 
(now, when descending from the ventilation, the character simply rolls past the table).

7. Added hidden locations for 2 future free DLC

notes.title: Fix problems and misinterpreted quests.
notes.content:
I want to offer my deepest apologies to all those who have been inconvenienced and difficulties, hints and tasks related to them.

After leaving the beta version, the game broke down, at the moment of fresh builds, I couldn't figure out what was going on for a long time, but I did it. I added additional notes and redrawn the hints to the solutions, read carefully, all the answers are usually indicated in the notes.

Thank you so much for your patience and for continuing to support me! At the moment I'm sick, so I can't fix it quickly, if you are experiencing any difficulties or problems, write to me by email sjdeveloper@mail.ru

I will always be happy to help you!
